title: Voxtext Translation Manifest
description: Contract between Voxtext (writer) and an automated translation flow (reader). See MANIFEST_SCHEMA.md for the full spec and how a flow consumes it.

courseName.description: Human-readable course/batch name, from the Translation Manifest panel's course name field (falls back to the source folder name if left blank).

sourceFolder.description: SharePoint document-library-relative path to the source folder (e.g. '/Shared Documents/Training/Onboarding'). Used as the destination folder when the flow writes the translated VTT back. Omitted if Voxtext couldn't compute it (Base cloud folder not set in Options).

sourceFileName.description: The source-language VTT transcript Voxtext writes alongside the video: '<video_id>_transcript.vtt'.

translatePrompt.description: Segment-tagged wire text, one '[[id]] text' line per segment, newline-joined. In the source language, and it contains no instructions, only the text. Pre-built by Voxtext so the flow does not need its own compose step -- feed this directly to your translation step. When the Context Hint field is set, a leading 'Content context: <hint>' line plus a blank line is prepended -- register/terminology guidance only, not tagged, omitted entirely when the hint is blank.

id.description: 1-based, sequential, matches translatePrompt's [[id]] tags. Stable across the translate round-trip.

start.description: HH:MM:SS.mmm, zero-padded, '.' separator -- Voxtext's exact VTT timestamp format. Copy verbatim into the output VTT cue.

end.description: HH:MM:SS.mmm, same format as start. Must be >= start.
